text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange 36 mm across, 2 mm thick; tube 30 mm across,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm tall overall; bore 24.0 mm to suit the probe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flange down in ASA in an enclosed printer. Measure your probe

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: first and print the bore 0.1 to 0.2 mm under it, for a push fit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Add a 2.5 mm hole through the tube wall 6 mm above the flange and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tap it M3 for a nylon-tipped grub screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: push the probe through the cover hole from outside so its face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stands 14.5 mm proud. Seal the gap in the hole with neutral-cure

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: silicone; slide the collar over the probe from inside and bond the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange to the floor with two-part plastics epoxy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tighten the grub screw finger tight once the epoxy has cured.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the probe does not move when pushed by hand.
